## Harvard-Oxford
```{r}
# VBM

                  sep = "=",
                  header = FALSE,

  "Occipital Fusiform Gyrus" = "Occipital Fusiform",

colnames(VBM) <- c("index", "IC", "direction", "modality", "hemisphere", "atlas", "overlap_pct")

# renaming and removing columns 
VBM_37 <- VBM[VBM$IC == "IC36", ]
VBM_37 <- merge(VBM_37, labels, by.x = "index", by.y = "New Index")
VBM_37 <- VBM_37[,-2]
VBM_37 <- VBM_37[VBM_37$overlap_pct != 0, ]
VBM_37 <- VBM_37 [order(VBM_37$overlap_pct, decreasing = TRUE),]

colnames(VBM_37)

colnames(VBM_37) <-  c("StructName", "direction", "modality", "hemisphere", "overlap_pct", "atlas", "index")  
colnames(VBM_37)
```

```{r}
shorten <- function(x) {
  dplyr::recode(x,
    "Juxtapositional Lobule Cortex" = "SMA",
    "Postcentral Gyrus"             = "PoCG",
    "Precentral Gyrus"              = "PreCG",
    "Occipital Fusiform"            = "Occipital FFG",
    "Fusiform, posterior"           = "FFG, posterior",
    "Temporo-occipital Fusiform"    = "Temporo-occipital FFG",
    "Angular Gyrus"                 = "AG",
    "Lingual Gyrus"                 = "LG",
    "Superior Frontal"              = "SFG",
    "Superior Frontal Sulcus"       = "SFS",
    "Middle Frontal"                = "MFG",
    "Middle Frontal Sulcus"         = "MFS",
    "Inferior Frontal Sulcus"       = "IFS",
    "Inferior Temporal"             = "ITG",
    "Middle Temporal"               = "MTG",
    "Lateral Superior Temporal"     = "STG, lateral",
    "Superior Temporal Sulcus"      = "STS",
    "Transverse Temporal Sulcus"    = "Transverse temporal S.",
    "Superior Parietal"             = "SPL",
    "Supramarginal"                 = "SMG",
    "Superior Occipital"            = "SOG",
    "Superior Occipital Sulcus"     = "SOS",

    "Anterior Cingulate"            = "ACC",

    "Pericallosal Sulcus"           = "Pericallosal S.",
    "Central Sulcus"                = "CS",
    "Precentral"                    = "PreCG",
    "Postcentral"                   = "PoCG",

    "Calcarine Sulcus"              = "Calcarine S.",

    "Orbital Gyrus"                 = "Orbital gyrus",
    "Inferior Circular Insula"      = "Inf. circular insula",
    "Superior Circular Insula"      = "Sup. circular insula",
    "Long Insular Gyrus"            = "Long insular gyrus",
    "Short Insular Gyrus"           = "Short insular gyrus"
  )
}


make_bar <- function(df, hemi, dir, ttl, sub, fill_scale, n_top = 8) {
  d <- df[df$hemisphere == hemi & df$direction == dir, ]
  d$StructName <- shorten(as.character(d$StructName))
  top <- d %>% group_by(StructName) %>% summarise(tot = sum(overlap_pct)) %>%
    slice_max(tot, n = n_top, with_ties = FALSE)
  d <- d %>% filter(StructName %in% top$StructName) %>%
    mutate(StructName = factor(StructName, levels = rev(top$StructName)))
  ggplot(d, aes(x = StructName, y = overlap_pct, fill = modality)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75, show.legend = TRUE) + coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 4) +
    fill_scale + small_theme +
    labs(title = ttl, subtitle = sub, x = NULL, y = "Overlap (%)")
}

p2 <- make_bar(vol_cort_all, "R", "pos", "Right hemisphere", "NAI > autism", vol_fill)
p3 <- make_bar(vol_cort_all, "L", "neg", NULL,               "Autism > NAI", vol_fill)
p4 <- make_bar(vol_cort_all, "R", "neg", NULL,               "Autism > NAI", vol_fill)

p7 <- make_bar(surf_data, "L", "neg", NULL,               "Autism > NAI", surf_fill)
p8 <- make_bar(surf_data, "R", "neg", NULL,               "Autism > NAI", surf_fill)

pb <- (p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
pc <- (p5 + p6) / (p7 + p8) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")

make_bar_v <- function(df, hemi, dir, ttl, sub, fill_scale, n_top = 10) {
  d <- df[df$hemisphere == hemi & df$direction == dir, ]
  d$StructName <- shorten(as.character(d$StructName))
  top <- d %>% group_by(StructName) %>% summarise(tot = sum(overlap_pct)) %>%
    slice_max(tot, n = n_top, with_ties = FALSE)
  d <- d %>% filter(StructName %in% top$StructName) %>%
    mutate(StructName = factor(StructName, levels = top$StructName))   # largest on the left
  ggplot(d, aes(x = StructName, y = overlap_pct, fill = modality)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75, show.legend = TRUE) +
    scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 4, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    fill_scale + small_theme +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line()) +
    labs(title = ttl, subtitle = sub, x = NULL, y = "Overlap (%)")
}

p1 <- make_bar_v(all_data, "L", "pos", "Left hemisphere",  "NAI > autism", all_fill)
p2 <- make_bar_v(all_data, "R", "pos", "Right hemisphere", "NAI > autism", all_fill)
p3 <- make_bar_v(all_data, "L", "neg", NULL,               "Autism > NAI", all_fill)
p4 <- make_bar_v(all_data, "R", "neg", NULL,               "Autism > NAI", all_fill)

p_all <- (p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Plots/modality_overlap_combined_rotated.pdf',
       p_all, width = 11.5, height = 15, units = "cm")
```

```{r}
make_wide <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(Modality   = recode(toupper(modality), "PA" = "SA"),   # surface area (white surface)
           key        = paste(direction, Modality, sep = "_"),
           StructName = recode(StructName, "Brain-Stem" = "Brainstem"),
           hemisphere = ifelse(hemisphere %in% c("lh", "L"), "L", "R")) %>%
    group_by(StructName, hemisphere, key) %>%
    summarise(overlap = sum(overlap_pct), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = overlap)
}


make_ft <- function(wide, dir_labels, mods) {
  cols <- c(); spans <- c(); spanlab <- c()
  for (d in names(dir_labels)) {
    present <- intersect(paste(d, mods, sep = "_"), names(wide))
    if (length(present) > 0) {
      cols <- c(cols, present); spans <- c(spans, length(present))
      spanlab <- c(spanlab, dir_labels[[d]])
    }
  }
  wide <- wide[, c("StructName", "hemisphere", cols)]
  # sort by largest overlap in any column
  wide$max <- apply(wide[, cols, drop = FALSE], 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
  wide <- wide %>% arrange(desc(max)) %>% select(-max)
  wide <- wide %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(cols), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), "–", formatC(.x, format = "f", digits = 2))))

  hdr <- setNames(as.list(c("Region", "Hemisphere", sub("^.*_", "", cols))), names(wide))

  flextable(wide) %>%
    set_header_labels(values = hdr) %>%
    add_header_row(values = c("", spanlab), colwidths = c(2, spans)) %>%
    flextable::theme_apa() %>%
    font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
    fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") %>%
    align(j = 2:ncol(wide), align = "center", part = "all") %>%
    align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") %>%
    padding(padding.top = 1, padding.bottom = 1, part = "body") %>%
    autofit()
}


tnr <- function(...) fp_text(font.family = "Times New Roman", font.size = 12, ...)
add_tab <- function(doc, num, title, ft, note) {
  doc %>%
    body_add_fpar(fpar(ftext(num, tnr(bold = TRUE)))) %>%
    body_add_fpar(fpar(ftext(title, tnr(italic = TRUE)))) %>%
    body_add_flextable(ft) %>%
    body_add_fpar(fpar(ftext("Note. ", tnr(italic = TRUE)), ftext(note, tnr()))) %>%
    body_add_par("")
}

dir37 <- c(pos = "NAI > autism", neg = "Autism > NAI")
dir1  <- c(pos = "Higher ADOS-2", neg = "Lower ADOS-2")

note_sub <- "Values indicate the percentage of suprathreshold voxels (95th percentile of the spatial map, positive and negative loadings separately) falling within each region of the Harvard–Oxford subcortical atlas. Dashes indicate no overlap."
note_srf <- "Values indicate the percentage of suprathreshold vertices (95th percentile of the spatial map, positive and negative loadings separately) falling within each region of the Destrieux atlas. Dashes indicate no overlap."
```
